**Problem / use case**

**Does it fit crew's scope?**
crew is intentionally small: no task dependency graph, no ordering, no caching, no build-system
behavior (see **Non-goals** in the README). Briefly note why this belongs in crew rather than in the
project's own runner (make / npm / a script).
